_comment: Identified-particle dN/dy at midrapidity per centrality and the kinetic freeze-out blast-wave parameters. Sources: ALICE PRC 88 (2013) 044910 arXiv:1303.0737 Tables 3-5 (Pb-Pb 2.76 TeV); ALICE arXiv:1910.07678 (5.02 TeV, 0-5% and 80-90%); ALICE PLB 728 (2014) 216 arXiv:1307.5543 (Xi, Omega); ALICE arXiv:1404.0495 (phi); ALICE arXiv:1506.08951 (d); STAR PRC 79 (2009) 034909 arXiv:0808.2041 Tables VII-X (Au-Au 200 GeV). Neutral yields: pi0 = (pi+ + pi-)/2, K0 + K0bar = K+ + K-, n = p, nbar = pbar, Lambda taken as 0.5 * (Xi + ...): Lambda dN/dy from ALICE PRL 111 222301 not extracted -> estimated from Lambda/pi ~ 0.036 (statistical hadronization, Andronic et al. Nature 561 (2018) 321) [flagged approximate].

PbPb_2760._note: Xi, Omega, phi, d outside the measured bins are scaled with pi+ (same centrality dependence assumed) [approximate]

PbPb_5020._note: 0-5% and 80-90% from ALICE 1910.07678; intermediate centralities interpolated in log(dN/dy); strange/phi/d scaled from 2.76 TeV by the pion ratio [approximate]

AuAu_200._note: 0-5% from STAR 0808.2041; 70-80% values and strange yields at RHIC are order-of-magnitude scalings [approximate; verify with STAR PRC 79 034909 Tab. VII/VIII and STAR PRL 98 062301]

pPb_5020._note: blast wave: ALICE PLB 728 (2014) 25 arXiv:1307.6796 Table 5 (V0A 0-5% and 80-100%); <pT> 0-5%: HEPData ins1244523 Tables 18-21. Species ratios: Pb-Pb 5.02 TeV 0-5% ratios assumed (relative normalisation only), deuteron halved for the smaller source [approximate]
